general.unknownError: Unknown error. See the Shopware log for details.

install.title: Install plugin from GitHub
install.warning: Plugins contain executable code with full access to your shop. Only install plugins from sources you trust.
install.noVersions: No versions compatible with this Shopware version were found.
install.branchesDisabledHint: Installing from branches is disabled in the plugin configuration.
install.branchWarning: Branches are not fixed releases and may contain unfinished code.
install.activateAfterInstall: Install and activate right after downloading
install.success: Plugin "{name}" has been installed from GitHub.
install.packageRelease: The ready-made release package "{asset}" provided by the vendor will be installed.
install.packageSource: The source code of this version will be installed (no release package available).
install.waiting: Shopware is still setting up the plugin (themes are being compiled). With several shops this can take 1–2 minutes – please keep this window open …

card.upToDate: {name} is up to date (latest version on GitHub: {version}).
card.unlinkSuccess: The GitHub link of {name} has been removed. The plugin itself is unchanged.
card.noReleases: No matching version of {name} was found on GitHub. Create a release (e.g. tag v1.0.0) or enable branch installs. Details: "…" → "Test connection".

linkModal.title: Link {name} to GitHub
linkModal.intro: Once linked, this plugin can be updated directly from its GitHub repository. Nothing changes on the plugin itself.
linkModal.label: GitHub repository
linkModal.allowListHint: Only repositories listed under "Allowed repositories" in the plugin configuration are possible (empty = all). Private repositories need a GitHub token.

test.hint: Checks access, composer.json and compatible versions – nothing is installed.
test.summaryOk: All good – the repository can be linked and used for updates.
test.summaryError: There are problems. See the details above and "Troubleshooting" in the README.

catalog.title: Plugin catalog
catalog.intro: Reviewed Shopware plugins that can be installed and updated directly from GitHub. Where the vendor provides a ready-made release package, it is used.

warnings.adminNotBuilt: The package contains no built administration – the plugin settings pages may be missing. Solution: use a release with a ready-made ZIP or build the administration (see README).
warnings.storefrontNotBuilt: The package contains no built storefront JavaScript – shop features may be missing. Solution: use a release with a ready-made ZIP or build the storefront.
warnings.missingDependencies: Requires additional Composer packages: {packages}. Shopware installs them automatically if the plugin supports it. Only if the plugin reports errors afterwards (e.g. "Class … not found" in the log), run "composer require {packages}" in the shop directory.
warnings.activationFailed: The plugin files were placed, but Shopware could not install/activate the plugin ({error}). Usually compiling the themes just took too long: activate the plugin in the list via its toggle or "…" → "Install", otherwise use "plugin:install --activate" on the console. Details in the Shopware log.
warnings.activatedAfterTimeout: {name} is installed and active. Shopware just took longer to respond (usually because of theme compilation) – nothing to do.
warnings.updateFailed: The new files are in place, but Shopware has not finished the update yet ({error}). Run "Update" on the plugin card or "plugin:update <name>" on the console. Details in the Shopware log.
